character.name: Astro
character.description: A small astronaut with a round helmet, a yellow star badge, and a friendly smile.

phrases.encourage: Good try! Let's look at the pieces again.
phrases.proud: Ready for your next space mission?

story.welcomeBody: The stars broke into pieces. Pick a world, then help your friend put equal pieces back together.
story.lessonDescription: Help Astro gather broken star pieces by adding fractions with the same denominator.
story.introStory: Welcome, Space Explorer! The stars have broken into pieces. Let's help Astro put them back together by learning about fractions!
story.objective: Add fractions that have the same denominator.
story.introReadAloud: Welcome, Space Explorer! The stars have broken into pieces. Let's help Astro put them back together by learning about fractions. Today we will add fractions that have the same denominator.
story.outroMessage: You helped Astro gather the star pieces.
story.outroReadAloud: The stars are shining again! You helped Astro gather the star pieces. When fractions have the same denominator, the pieces are the same size. Add the numerators. The denominator stays the same.

identify-fraction.instruction: One piece of this star is glowing. Which fraction matches it?
identify-fraction.supportingText: The star is split into equal pieces.
identify-fraction.readAloud: One piece of this star is glowing. The star is split into equal pieces. Which fraction matches it?

add-fifths.instruction: Astro has 1/5 of a star and finds 2/5 more. How much is that altogether?
add-fifths.readAloud: Astro has 1 fifth of a star and finds 2 fifths more. How much is that altogether?

type-eighths.supportingText: You can type a fraction or a decimal.
type-eighths.readAloud: Type the sum of 2 eighths and 3 eighths. You can type a fraction or a decimal.

number-line-fourths.supportingText: The marks are evenly spaced fourths.
number-line-fourths.readAloud: Tap the mark that shows 1 fourth plus 2 fourths. The marks are evenly spaced fourths.

add-tenths.supportingText: Gold and blue pieces are the same size.
add-tenths.readAloud: Gold and blue pieces are the same size. Which bar shows 4 tenths plus 3 tenths?
